meta.name: remotion-render
meta.description: Render videos from React/Remotion component code via inference.sh. Pass TSX code, get MP4. Supports all Remotion APIs: useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig, spring, interpolate, AbsoluteFill, Sequence. Configurable resolution, FPS, duration, codec. Use for: programmatic video generation, animated graphics, motion design, data-driven videos, React animations to video. Triggers: remotion, render video from code, tsx to video, react video, programmatic video, remotion render, code to video, animated video, motion graphics code, react animation video

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 React 组件代码渲染成 MP4 视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用代码批量生成视频或动画
copy.tagline_en: Render React components into MP4 videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate videos or animations programmatically

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以接受你提供的 React/Remotion 组件代码（TSX），通过 inference.sh 服务渲染成 MP4 视频，并返回视频文件。
howto.when: 当你提到“remotion”、“render video from code”、“tsx to video”等关键词，或要求从代码生成视频时触发。

say.text: 用这段 TSX 代码生成一个 3 秒的渐变文字视频。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Remotion 渲染工具来处理。

say.text: 帮我渲染一个带弹簧动画的方块，分辨率 1080p。
say.note: 会使用 spring 动画效果。

say.text: 把这个 React 组件渲染成视频，宽度 1920，高度 1080。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can accept your React/Remotion component code (TSX) and render it into an MP4 video via inference.sh, returning the video file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "remotion", "render video from code", "tsx to video", or ask to generate a video from code.

say_en.text: Generate a 3-second fade-in text video from this TSX code.
say_en.note: Claude will invoke the Remotion render tool.

say_en.text: Render a square with a spring animation at 1080p resolution.
Render this React component as a video, width 1920, height 1080.
say_en.note: You can specify dimensions and duration.
